title: Roswell/Corona crash confirmed via Ed Mitchell and Admiral Wilson

tellings.quote: I had my uh information I got from Ed Mitchell at a science advisory board meeting about the Greer briefings on the disclosure project at at the Pentagon and then Admiral Wilson coming back and verifying that the Roswell crash well the Corona crash actually really did happen. It wasn't a mogul balloon.

plain: The 1947 crash near Roswell, New Mexico, which happened on a ranch near the town of Corona, is said to have been a real crash and not a Mogul balloon, the secret Army balloon later given as the official explanation, according to a Navy admiral named Thomas R. Wilson, a senior military intelligence official. Eric W. Davis, a physicist who has worked as a Pentagon scientist, tells Michels he heard this from the Apollo astronaut Ed Mitchell at a science advisory board meeting. As Davis relays it, Mitchell described briefings at the Pentagon by the UFO activist Steven Greer about his Disclosure Project, a campaign to get officials to reveal UFO secrets, after which Wilson came back and "verif[ied] that the Roswell crash, well the Corona crash, actually really did happen." If true, it would mean a senior officer confirmed the most famous UFO crash story.
